title: War Intensity & Battlefield
scope: Frontline developments, territorial changes, offensives, strikes on cities and infrastructure, casualties, drone/missile warfare.

title: Peace Initiatives & Negotiations
scope: Ceasefire proposals, peace plans, talks, envoys, positions of Kyiv/Moscow/Washington on terms, security guarantees.

title: International Support for Ukraine
scope: Military, financial and political aid from the US, Europe and others; NATO/EU decisions; coalition of the willing; frozen assets financing.

title: Sanctions & Economic Pressure
scope: Sanctions on Russia, oil/gas revenues, price caps, shadow fleet, trade measures, effect on the Russian economy.

title: Conflicting Parties' Resources
scope: Manpower, mobilisation, weapons production and stocks, defence budgets, energy supply, economic capacity of Russia and Ukraine; third-country support to Russia (e.g. North Korea, Iran, China).

title: Domestic Politics & Governance
scope: Internal politics in Ukraine and Russia relevant to the war: leadership changes, corruption cases, public opinion, elections, repression.

title: Humanitarian Impact
scope: Civilians, refugees, deportations of children, prisoners of war, occupied territories, energy/heating crises affecting the population.

title: Escalation Risks & Wider Security
scope: Nuclear rhetoric, threats to NATO states, airspace incursions, sabotage, hybrid attacks, spillover risks.

title: Expectations & Outlook
scope: Forecasts and expert expectations about the course of the war, negotiations, or its end.
